classified_conditions.condition_text: IF WS-RESPONSE-CODE = DFHRESP(NORMAL)  -> POSITION-EXISTS else NO-POSITION
IF RECV-SUCCESS -> retry connect else -> error
IF file open failed (either file) -> terminate
READ ... AT END / NOT AT END
IF invalid (ID/client blank or status<>'A') -> count error + skip
EVALUATE write status: success / duplicate / other
READ NEXT ... AT END / NOT AT END
EVALUATE read status: success / not-found / other
READ ... AT END / NOT AT END
IF portfolio read success -> apply update else count not-found
IF rewrite success -> count update else count error
WHILE NOT END-OF-FILE OR WS-ERROR-COUNT > 100 (loop guard with an error cap)
READ ... AT END / NOT AT END
IF NOT BCT-STATUS-DONE + IF hard dep -> warning
ELSE IF dep return code too high -> error
ELSE IF any still active -> warning
IF audit-file open failed -> terminate + return
IF audit write failed -> rc=8 else rc=0
IF log open failed -> display (continues anyway)
WHILE NOT connected AND retries<3 (retry loop)
IF SQLCODE=0 -> connected else handle error
IF retries left AND not connected -> DELAY
IF reset SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error
IF status SELECT SQLCODE=0 -> active else not active
IF threshold reached OR forced -> commit
IF commit SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log
IF rollback SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log
IF savepoint SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log
IF restore SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log
EVALUATE SQLCODE: deadlock/timeout / connection / dup-key / not-found / other(+/-)
IF insert SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error
IF retrieve SQLCODE=0 -> return latest else 'no history'
IF create failed AND not 'already exists' -> error
IF insert SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error
IF update SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error
IF final update SQLCODE=0 -> display else error
IF select SQLCODE=0 -> display else error
IF OPEN SQLCODE=0 -> ok else return sqlcode
READ ... AT END / NOT AT END
READ ... AT END / NOT AT END
